title: platform-measurement: simulation study code for "Is the Platform Part of the Measurement?"
description: Code and materials for the simulation study (Section 7 and Figure 1) of the paper "Is the Platform Part of the Measurement? A Protocol and Simulation Study for Cross-Platform Equivalence of Machine-Labelled Policy Sentiment" (2026). A known-ground-truth simulation compares a naive pooled cross-platform sentiment index with a measurement-adjusted index; scenario checks, the fifteen UK fiscal policy anchor events and the collection keyword scheme are included. No social media data.
